about.title: About deVino

why.heading: Why deVino
why.body: The world is not short of clothes. Our question was never what else could be made, but why anything new should exist at all. Our answer was a woman whose presence never needs to raise its voice.

shoulder.heading: We Begin at the Shoulder
shoulder.body: Before designing, we watched the body, looking for the place where a person's presence appears first. We found it at the shoulder, the line we associate with endurance and standing tall. Every deVino piece begins there, and any detail that doesn't follow that line is left out.

name.heading: The Name: From a Cup
name.body: The name deVino grew from a familiar word that Persian defines as a cup: a vessel that means little on its own and becomes complete only when it passes to another hand. A cup belongs to gatherings, to evenings made whole by the presence of others. deVino is not the name of an object. It names the moment something passes between a woman and what she wears.

about.closing: Beauty is born of the relationship between a woman and her dress, never from one overpowering the other.
